prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, scan area, take or grab object, process it. If can't grab, scan again. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToScannedArea    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsAreaScanned    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
